host: Oracle Ampere A1, 2 vCPU shared with production containers
notes: Each request carries 3 bubble crops of one language, like the refused bubbles of one page.
Runs inside a temporary container built from the deployed mediavault-lmt image plus this branch; production containers untouched.
The first request includes Chromium start and OCR model load (cold).
v1 = without English case normalisation, v2 = final code (sentence-cased English before Hy-MT2).

textRefusalProbe.description: Adult/violent lines sent directly to Hy-MT2 with the official prompt: does the non-Google model refuse?
